subject: cr-info-dy
title: CR.INFO.DY.------C.INFO.
description: Diagram in WM-28, on the page where Braxton argues that 'the essence alignment of world creativity is based on the synthesis of concept and spiritualism.' CR-INFO-DY (circular information dynamics) is *crossed* with C-INFO (composite information). Besides the main line to C-INFO, two argumentative arcs flow from the subject. Through SOC-RT (social reality) → CULT-INFO-F (culture information focus) → (r)INDIV-DY-RT (the reality of individual dynamic reality) → INDIV-TD (individual tendencies) → LANG-DY (language dynamics) → LK-IMP (linkage implications) → T-C-IMP (time continuum implications): this arc traces how circular information moves from social reality into individual tendencies, and from there through the language-dynamics filter into linkage implications and implications across the time continuum. Through ASP-ES (aspect essence) → (r)INTR (interpretation) → MT-INFO (multi-information): this arc runs from aspect essence through the reality of interpretation into multi-information. The crossing's argument: world creativity's information-dynamics requires the synthesis of both arcs, the very synthesis whose implication, per Braxton on this page, is rarely dealt with.
